dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are concentrated in the mid-dorsal-lateral region. Perimeters show sharp dark boundaries transitioning abruptly to high-intensity light centers; at least four prominent closed 'O' structures exhibit well-defined, continuous edge gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients is observed between the larger annuli, particularly towards the ventral edge and posterior third. These clusters appear as localized, asymmetrical islands of white/light-gray pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent central annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary grouping of three annuli in the anterior region forms a narrow-angled acute triangle.
